name: POST /api/api-keys/{key_id}/rotate - Rotate with a grace window
description: Issues a replacement carrying the same application, scopes, limit and expiry, and moves the previous key to rotating so it keeps working for a 24 hour grace window - that overlap is what lets a caller deploy the new credential before the old one stops. Returns the new plaintext exactly once. Constrained to the tenant of the caller: rotating used to take only a key_id, so any signed-in user could rotate the key of any other customer and read the new plaintext straight out of this response. A key_id belonging to another tenant now answers 404.

errorCases.name: A key in another tenant answers 404 and mints nothing
